title: Lior and the Room
author: Zephyrine Vane
blurb: Noor Fairweather, the new teacher at a school with a missing-class problem, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. But when all the photographs from grandma's house now include an extra chair, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must return what was taken in 1974 before the harvest moon rises.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
